synth.notes:
Lights-out grid: 6x6 cells spaced 8; ACTION6 hits object whose bbox contains (x,y).
Tile (editable) click toggles color_14<->color_15.
Operator click toggles its marker_14<->15 and the 4 orthogonally adjacent editable tiles (offset w+2/h+2); glyph neighbours untouched.
Glyph clicks, empty-space clicks and non-click actions are no-ops. Fully stateless.
Unconfirmed: behaviour for colors/markers other than 14/15, and for operator neighbours that are operators.
